title: TemporaryCustomerPostRequest
description: A registered customer. Required fields are expirationDate, createdBy and createdByChannel.

countryCode.description: Telephone number country code, starting with +.

createdBy.description: Who created the customer. Either web, app or username of employee. Used for traceability in accordance with GDPR

createdByChannel.description: Which sales channel or system who created the customer. Used for traceability in accordance with GDPR

customerAccountId.description: Deprecated. Use /profiles/{customerNumber}/customer-accounts. Customer account id used for account based ticketing

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth. ISO 8601 date format

expirationDate.description: The date when the customers personal data should be deleted. Personal data will be deleted continuously. ISO 8601 date format

organisationId.description: The organisation the customer is registered with.

telephoneNumber.description: Deprecated. Please use countryCode and telephoneNumberNoCountryCode. Telephone number for customer. This should be a cell phone number.

telephoneNumberNoCountryCode.description: Telephone number without country code or punctuation.
